docs: Unlike packages/core this one DOES take Node's ambient types. The schemas, samples
and SNS helpers are pure and run anywhere, but `generate-json-schema.ts` is a build
tool that reads and writes files — it is the thing that produces the committed JSON
Schema, and it only ever runs on Node.
The purity that matters here is of the payloads, not the package: no event body may
carry user content, which `test/events.test.ts` enforces by trying to put some in.
